ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: inventory-service: p99 latency above 1000ms for 5 minutes (since 15:43 UTC)
Alerting service: inventory
Alert time: 2026-06-10T15:43:00Z
Data available from 2026-06-10T14:00:00Z to 2026-06-10T17:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 1 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-06-10T16:43:00Z", "metric": "latency_p99_ms", "service": "inventory", "start": "2026-06-10T14:43:00Z"} (asked because: Check latency evolution for inventory service around the alert time.)
  Result: M-024: Change detected at 2026-06-10T15:30:00Z: mean 120.36 before, 4810.95 after (528.9 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-024] inventory.latency_p99_ms from 2026-06-10T14:45:00Z to 2026-06-10T16:40:00Z (24 points, 5-minute steps): min=104.46 max=5756.28 mean=3051.98 last=5746.51; mean=3051.98. Change detected at 2026-06-10T15:30:00Z: mean 120.36 before, 4810.95 after (528.9 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-06-10T14:45:00Z = 104.46 (lowest); 2026-06-10T15:30:00Z = 1057.61 (first point after the change); 2026-06-10T16:10:00Z = 5756.28 (peak); 2026-06-10T16:40:00Z = 5746.51 (last).
Step 2: metrics_query {"end": "2026-06-10T16:43:00Z", "metric": "db_pool_in_use_pct", "service": "inventory", "start": "2026-06-10T14:43:00Z"} (asked because: Check database connection pool usage for inventory service.)
  Result: M-021: Change detected at 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z: mean 28.22 before, 53.77 after (22.6 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-021] inventory.db_pool_in_use_pct from 2026-06-10T14:45:00Z to 2026-06-10T16:40:00Z (24 points, 5-minute steps): min=27.31 max=77.12 mean=50.58 last=73.73; mean=50.58. Change detected at 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z: mean 28.22 before, 53.77 after (22.6 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-06-10T14:55:00Z = 27.31 (lowest); 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z = 31.85 (first point after the change); 2026-06-10T16:15:00Z = 77.12 (peak); 2026-06-10T16:40:00Z = 73.73 (last).
Step 3: log_search {"end": "2026-06-10T15:45:00Z", "limit": 30, "query": "slow query timeout database index", "service": "inventory", "start": "2026-06-10T15:33:00Z"} (asked because: Search inventory logs for slow query or database related issues around the start of the incident.)
  Result: 2 matching log lines.
  [L-0278] 2026-06-10T15:40:20Z inventory WARN slow query took 4298ms: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_ref = $1 rows_examined=4213877
  [L-0279] 2026-06-10T15:41:14Z inventory WARN query plan: Seq Scan on orders (rows=4213877) filter=(customer_ref = $1) no usable index

Previous hypotheses:
None yet.

response: {"summary": "The inventory service p99 latency spiked dramatically starting at 15:30 UTC. Database connection pool usage also increased. Log searches confirm a slow query performing a sequential scan on the orders table due to a missing index, causing high latency.", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "slow_query_missing_index", "rationale": "Logs show a slow query warning with a sequential scan on the orders table and a missing index, directly correlating with the latency spike.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-024", "L-0278", "L-0279"]}, {"root_cause_category": "db_connection_pool_exhaustion", "rationale": "Database connection pool usage increased notably during the time latency spiked, likely due to slow queries holding connections longer.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-021", "M-024"]}]}
